full_judgment:
Bimalendu Bikash Roy Chowdhury, J:- The petitioner is an accused under section 406/420 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act. 1947 before the Special Judge Third Court Pabna in Special Case No. 6 of 1996. 

 2. Briefly stated, the prosecution allegation is to the effect that an amount of Tk. 4,86,799.92 was received by the petitioner and his co-accused Md. Altaf Hossain Ex-Upazila Chairman and A.Z. Aminul Islam. Upazila Accounts Officer from the Government for construction of the science building of Mohammad Yasin Degree College. But it appeared from the case book that only Tk. 1,62,266.66 had been spent for the said purpose and the balance was misappropriated. 

 3. An Assistant Inspector, D.A.B. Investigated the case and submitted charge sheet under sections 406/420/ 109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947. 

 4. Eventually the Special Judge, Third Court, Pabna, took up the case for trial and upon hearing the parties under section 265C of the Code of Criminal Procedure framed charge against the petitioner and others under sections 406/420 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947. 

 5. The petitioner moved the High Court Division with an application, being Criminal Misc. Case No. 2893 of 1998 under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure of quashing the criminal proceeding against him.
